dataConditions.name: validate expressions
dataConditions.condition: ${ (.expressions | length == 0) or (.expressions[].status | length == 0 ) or  (.expressions[].condition | length == 0) or (.expressions[].status | contains(null)) or (.expressions[].condition | contains(null)) }

actionDataFilter.results: ${ if .status == 200 and (.data) then .data else null end }

dataConditions.name: if result has error
dataConditions.condition: ${ if any(.utilExecutorData[]; .status == "error" and .result == true) then true else false end }

dataConditions.name: if result has failed
dataConditions.condition: ${ if any(.utilExecutorData[]; .status == "success" and .result == false) then true else false end }
